title: Localization, Verification & OLED Improvements
headline: SwitchControl 1.3.0 brings complete public-site localization, keeps network states verified against Windows, and makes important controls easier to discover.
changes: Added complete localized public landing-page copy, including Tamil coverage across every section and shared website surface
Added true OLED Black theming with pure-black backgrounds and near-black card surfaces across legacy and modern UI panels
Network Tweaks now always verifies live Windows registry and netsh state in Electron instead of trusting a fresh cached status
Made tweak info, graph/impact, and advanced-details controls persistently discoverable with accent styling, hover feedback, and a gentle attention pulse
Added synchronized top-to-bottom blur and fade icon reveals for Startup Apps and Debloat Installed Apps after scans
Made BIOS Advisor advanced firmware details easier to find and expanded the Startup Telemetry scan card
Added reliable drag-handle reordering for Settings sidebar and dashboard sections
Added real Windows System Restore point creation before tweak applies when the preference is enabled, with a clear failure instead of silently continuing
